title: Uruguayan Beef Wrap
description: A flavorful and savory beef wrap with a Uruguayan twist, served with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the beef with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, roast the red onion and bell pepper in the oven with some olive oil and salt until tender.
Slice the beef into thin strips and set aside.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the zesty mayo on the corned beef wrap, followed by the grilled beef, roasted vegetables, and any additional toppings you like.
